notes.title: Hauntsters Soundtrack!
notes.content:
We've gotten a lot of requests for the fantastic electroswing music featured in Hauntsters, so without further ado, here is the iTunes link to the album that all these great tracks came from!

https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/remote/id945790618

Album: "Remote"
Band: Swingrowers
Label: Freshly Squeezed Music
